question:
The following graph shows the percentage rise in the profits of two companies over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af814d4a7101bf394820752fbbd9e6dd90fabc4e18638eef6f474de08c8e4dd1.png] 

What is the average of the percentage increases in the year-to-year profit of Company M over all the given years, taken together? [Give your answer correct to the nearest integer value.]
solution:
**Given:**

Increase in profit% of two companies M and L

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of values/ No. of values

**Calculation:**

Here, we have % increase in profit of company M = 25 in 2004, 10 in 2005, 15 in 2006, 25 in 2007, 20 in 2008, 30 in 2009 

⇒ Sum of % increase in profit from 2004 to 2009 = ( 25 + 10 + 15 + 25 + 20 + 30) = 125

⇒ Number of years = 6

⇒ Average = 125/6 = 20.83% ≈ 21%

**Hence, the average of percentage increase is 21%.**
